commit.message:
Refactor trace logging into varargs helper function

Extract the repeated trace-and-check pattern into a
trace_compiler_thread_added() helper that handles the
ThreadsListHandle check, early-exit logging, and varargs
message formatting in one place.

Log a message when compiler thread exits before it could be tracked

Address review feedback: instead of silently skipping the trace
logging, print a message with the thread address to indicate
the thread exited early.

8377977: Crashes in CompileBroker::init_compiler_threads with -XX:+StressBailout and tracing enabled

With StressBailout, a newly created compiler thread can bail out and
exit before the creating thread takes a ThreadsListHandle to log
the creation. Replace the assert that assumed the thread is still
alive with a graceful skip of the trace logging.
